svg.aria-label: Pull model: the ApplicationSet on the hub generates Applications that the hub Argo CD ignores. The propagation controller wraps each Application into a ManifestWork in the cluster namespace, the work agent on the managed cluster pulls it and creates the Application, and the local Argo CD reconciles it. Status returns through the ManifestWork and ACM search into the MulticlusterApplicationSetReport

svg.text: all three in the pod multicluster-integrations
applied by the local Argo CD
The hub Argo CD only generates the Applications:
reconciliation happens on every spoke, with its own OpenShift GitOps.
No hub, still reconciliation. All connections are opened by the spoke.
Dashed arrows: status back to the hub.
